summary: Iteration 3 testing passed. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (100%) — no regressions across health, profile, screen-time, study-sets CRUD + save + saved filter, quiz start/answer/complete, rewards redeem, blocked-apps. Frontend (mobile 390x844) verified on preview URL: (a) Home oversized-bento hero renders with outer soft colored bento labeled 'Balance' + inner dark POINTS BALANCE card containing '25 pts', '45 min redeemed · 475 earned' + Redeem button (testIDs points-balance-card, points-value, redeem-shortcut present). (b) Marketplace rebuilt as bento: oversized rounded search bento + multi-color filter chips (filter-chip-Recent/Saved/Biology/Math etc present; Biology=green, Chemistry=purple, Computer Science=purple accent), 'Featured sets' horizontal carousel with 4 colored tiles (testIDs featured-TEST_Custom Set, featured-SAT Vocabulary [yellow], featured-World Geography, featured-Chemistry: Periodic Table), 'All sets' list with 13 studyset-card-* rows and per-subject colored avatars. Preview modal opens with preview-title, preview-save-wallet, preview-study-now, preview-save-btn. Save-to-wallet toggles text from 'Save to wallet' to 'In wallet'. (c) Flashcard flip on /studyset/{id}: front shows black card with flashcard-term 'Ephemeral', blue reveal-answer-btn; after tap, back face shows flashcard-definition ('Lasting for a very short time.') with 3 self-assessment buttons assess-got-it (green), assess-more-help (yellow), assess-not-quite (red) AND continue-card-btn all rendered; tapping assess-got-it advances to flashcard #2 (term becomes 'Ubiquitous', progress bar segment 2 highlights). (d) Quiz: quiz-subject-pill (blue 'language'), quiz-progress-bar (segmented, 1/5 highlighted), 2x2 quiz-option-0..3 grid, quiz-submit-button enabled after select; after submit the correct option (Ephemeral) highlights green, wrong (Ubiquitous) highlights red/pink, explanation renders 'not quite - …Ephemeral describes something that lasts only briefly'; quiz-next-button becomes enabled and advances to question 2. (e) Onboarding → tabs navigation still works; no React Native red-screen or page errors.

issues: Existing deprecation warnings 'shadow*' style props + 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' carried over from prior iterations — cosmetic only, no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: StudySet Pydantic model in server.py still lacks 'is_saved' — toggle_save persists it but StudySet(**d) drops it on list/get responses. Frontend preview modal reads is_saved from its own local state after POST /save, so functional today; add 'is_saved: bool = False' to the model for robustness.

Consider using id instead of title for testID suffix.
